Strategy 2 Buys Only When Price Is Above the 200 Average for 5 Candles — Nifty 50

On this page

  2. 2. Result (all 50 stocks added together)

Delivery buys, all 50 stocks, all timeframes, entries 1 Jan 2023 – 26 Oct 2026, FYERS charges only, ₹1,00,000 per trade. Education, not investment advice. Report with charges by type, by year and per stock: ../../../projects/trading-equation-backtests/reports/STRATEGY2_ABOVE_MA_REPORT.md. Every trade: reports/strategy2_above_ma/trades_all.csv.

1. The rules

Filter first: price has been above its 200 average for the last 5 candles. Tested two ways:

  • A (daily average): the last 5 daily closes are all above the 200-day average. Intraday timeframes use yesterday's check.
  • B (same timeframe): the last 5 candles of the timeframe you trade are all above that timeframe's 200-candle average (e.g. on 4-hour: the last 5 four-hour closes above the 200 four-hour-candle average).

Then Strategy 2: MACD histogram bigger than the previous candle and Stoch RSI blue crosses above orange with blue below 50 → buy at that close. Sell at the close of the first later candle where blue meets orange.

3. What it means

  • The filter helps a little but doesn't make the strategy work. 4-hour improves from −₹4.06L (no filter) to −₹1.77L (A) / −₹69k (B). Daily goes from −₹1.49L to +₹73k.
  • The daily profit is from the filter, not the entry. Random buys with the same filter make +₹57k, and Strategy 2 beats them only 56% of the time. Without its 3 best trades it's slightly negative.
  • On 4-hour the entry does beat random buys (91–93%), like in the uptrend test, but it still loses after FYERS charges: the move per trade (+0.23–0.26%) is just under the 0.28% delivery charge.
  • It only worked in 2023–2024, when most stocks were rising. In 2025–2026 every timeframe lost money.
  • 15-min to 1-hour lose with both filters. The trades are too short to cover the charges.
